new_results.statement: For a literal original one-hub residual with hub row m and projected physical crossing C, Z2=e2(CC^T)>0 implies a continuous C0 density bounded by 3*2^(7/6)*exp(1/3)*(||m||^2 Z2)^(-1/6), with no E2 row-marginal hypothesis. Heavy E2 volume is promoted to a second literal hub; heavy residual E1 volume is promoted to a third literal hub.

In the partner leakage branch, if Z2=e2((M[I,J](I-P_ellJ))(...)^T)>0 for the product-certified orientation, then the full density is <=9.73330945413282 |a|^(-5/12) W2^(-1/24) Z2^(-1/12), with no projected-volume row-marginal gate; exact-null constant improves to 9.18702077113785.
